items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: Yank? Yeah, I know all those fellas, knew them then.

ctx.x: Oh, they're down there, but my goodness. We'd have to go way back. Now, as much as I followed the band, why, if somebody died, we'd wait for the funeral, for the band to be played behind them. And I'd know everybody that played in the band, but I can't think of them now.
Well, do you remember the Johnson brothers over in Algiers, Yank and Buddy Johnson, the trombone?
That's who I was trying to say, who played trombone? Buddy Johnson, Little Shortfella. Do you remember them, Matt? Yeah, I remember Buddy Johnson.
